description: This file defines the EntityTypeInfo class for Drupal's content moderation module, handling entity type modifications, moderation support, form alterations, and bundle management.

classes.name: EntityTypeInfo
classes.description: Handles entity type modifications, moderation integration, form alterations, and bundle management within Drupal's content moderation module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EntityTypeInfo class with necessary services like translation, moderation info, entity type manager, bundle info, current user, and validator.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate EntityTypeInfo with services from the container.

methods.name: entityTypeAlter
methods.description: Adds moderation support to entity types that are revisionable and not excluded.

methods.name: addModerationToEntityType
methods.description: Modifies an entity definition to include moderation handler, link templates, and route provider.

methods.name: entityExtraFieldInfo
methods.description: Provides extra fields for bundles, such as moderation control.

methods.name: getModeratedBundles
methods.description: Generator yielding entity and bundle names that have moderation enabled.

methods.name: entityBaseFieldInfo
methods.description: Adds base field definitions like moderation state to moderated entity types.

methods.name: entityPrepareForm
methods.description: Replaces entity with a revision object during form editing for translatable entities.

methods.name: formAlter
methods.description: Alters bundle and entity forms to enforce revision handling and moderation states.

methods.name: isModeratedEntityEditForm
methods.description: Checks if a form is for editing a moderated entity.

methods.name: bundleFormRedirect
methods.description: Redirects to the latest version of an entity after save if there is a pending revision.
